hero.title:
A collaborative effort
to preserve seeds
hero.description: Seeds are living repositories of biodiversity, yet climate change, habitat loss, and unsustainable land use are driving many plant species toward extinction. SeedPeers is a non-profit peer-to-peer network of micro-greenhouses deployed in indoor environments such as homes, schools, and community buildings, where we cultivate and preserve seeds of plant species included in the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species , together with other locally threatened and underutilized species. Our aim is to turn citizens into active agents of biodiversity conservation by learning and practicing plant cultivation, propagation, and seed conservation. Together we cultivate the future.

greenhouse.title: Where Function Meets Form
greenhouse.description: The micro-greenhouses form the backbone of the SeedPeers network. Engineered to create ideal conditions for seed preservation and growth, they pair advanced functionality with a refined, minimalist design. More than just cultivation devices, they are living showcases of biodiversity that bring nature and beauty into our everyday spaces.

contact.title: Your voice matters
contact.description:
We’re building SeedPeers. Progress is going well, but we’re still early and your input can make a real difference. 

 Completing this form is entirely optional, but your input helps us understand your needs, prioritize features, and build a platform that truly serves the community. The only required field is your email address so we can stay in touch.

 Join us, stay updated, and help shape what comes next.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: This page is sample copy for a starter template. Replace it with your real policy and have it reviewed by qualified legal counsel before publishing.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: SeedPeers ("we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy. This policy describes how we handle information when you use our website and services (the "Services").

sections.title: Information we collect
list: Account data — such as name, email, and organization when you register or contact us.
Usage data — such as pages visited, approximate location (derived from IP), device type, and timestamps.
Technical data — such as browser type, cookies, and similar technologies as described below.

sections.title: How we use information
list: Provide, operate, and improve the Services;
Communicate with you about updates, security, and support;
Analyze usage in aggregated or de-identified form;
Comply with law and protect rights, safety, and security.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.text: We and our partners may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies for essential operation, preferences (such as theme), analytics, and marketing where permitted. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.title: Sharing and subprocessors
sections.text: We may share information with service providers who assist us (e.g. hosting, analytics, email delivery), subject to contracts that limit use to providing services on our behalf. We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect users and the public.

sections.title: Your rights and choices
sections.text: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export personal data, or to object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise these rights. You may also unsubscribe from marketing emails using the link in those messages.

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: We retain information only as long as necessary for the purposes above, unless a longer period is required by law.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the new version on this page and adjust the "Last updated" date.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: Questions about this policy: use the contact options on our website or reach your account representative.
